title: The Sales Type column header does not sort the report
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on, so that a work order can have a different Labor and Parts representative.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Have one split work order for that customer with Labor set to one of them and Parts set to the other, invoiced today. Neither of them has other invoices today.
  • Open Reports > Sales By Representative in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide, with the date range set to today, Show Unassigned on and the Sales Type column turned on.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Nothing happens.
  • The Sales Type column cannot be sorted.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: "SBR (Sales By Representative) Report" spec, Confluence 585629698, version 28 (12 Oct 2026), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type)

  • Sales By Representative spec, S11-R6: “Identifier columns are not sortable (Date, Invoice, Customer, Status, Sales Type do not respond to header clicks). The Date header carries the expand/collapse-all chevron, not a sort affordance.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
